publisher: USDOT Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) catalog; source data maintained by USACE Army Geospatial Center
bts_source_claim: The BTS IENC item says USACE/AGC updates the IENC dataset bi-monthly, links the master file geodatabase and official IENC Feature Classes service, and warns about chart data inaccuracies.
capture_policy: Retain decoded ESRI JSON bodies, exact HTTP wire bodies, and request receipts; store the complete native schema/attributes and rings in a typed GeoParquet candidate without reprojection or geometry repair.
completeness_policy: Independently read count and ID roster before and after the full page capture; compare exact expected native ID set, field declarations, CRS and full feature roster; validate native attribute types, identifiers, polygon rings and geometry validity; reject drift and quarantine incomplete responses.
freshness: BTS describes a bi-monthly update cadence. No source release date for this observed PIPE_AREA layer was present in the service response; fetch date is not used as a release date.
coverage_limit: Complete inland IENC chart feature class only. This is not nationwide land-pipeline coverage and should not be expanded to the entire LNG or pipeline universe.
lineage_limit: The official IENCCloud endpoint is explicitly linked by BTS and listed in the official service directory. The current PIPE_AREA layer is an exact published feature class, but it has not been compared with the archived HIFLD baseline or its original clipping/extraction rules; same-item continuity versus successor semantics is unresolved.
